_formspree_note: Paste the Formspree form ID (the part after /f/) to send the contact form straight to the inbox. Empty = the form opens the visitor's email app instead.
_newsletter_note: Form action URL from the newsletter provider (e.g. Buttondown or Brevo embed). Empty = signup hidden.
_insights_note: Insights appears in the menu once this many articles are published.
_socials_note: Add full profile URLs when the accounts exist. Empty ones are not shown.
_status_note: live = shows a link to url; held = no link yet; dev = 'In development' label, no link; inhouse = a BlueX business line

businesses.name: EkoBuja
businesses.summary: Co-ownership of income-producing property, in shares that co-owners can trade with each other.
detail: EkoBuja lets people co-own income-producing property. Each property is divided into shares. Co-owners receive their part of the rent, and can sell their shares to other co-owners.
EkoBuja is operated as a separate company.

businesses.name: Prenniex
businesses.summary: Solar hybrid systems, battery storage and electrical installation for homes, businesses and institutions across Nigeria.
detail: Prenniex Global Solutions designs, supplies, installs and maintains solar hybrid power systems, battery storage and electrical installations for homes, businesses and institutions across Nigeria.
It is operated as a separate company, with its own engineers and installation crews.

businesses.name: GaugeLoans
businesses.summary: A credit business for people and small businesses, now in development. It is not open for applications.
detail: GaugeLoans is a credit business we are building for people and small businesses in Nigeria.
It is in development. It does not offer loans or take applications, and will not until the required approvals are in place.

businesses.name: Structured Finance
businesses.summary: Working capital for suppliers, distributors and service providers, built around a real contract and repaid through its payment cycle.
detail: BlueX Structured Finance provides working capital to suppliers, distributors and service providers who have real contracts to deliver.
Each arrangement is tied to a specific contract or trade cycle, documented in full, and repaid from the payments that contract produces.

businesses.name: BlueX Ventures
businesses.summary: New businesses we start, partnerships with operators, and selective investments in companies we can help run.
detail: BlueX Ventures starts new businesses, partners with operators who need structure and capital, and makes selective investments in companies where we can help run things.
We look for real demand, a clear way to make money, and a part of the business where we can make a difference.
